profiles.label: Huawei A0 3.98 四色
profiles.qualification: Historical coupling-dependent partial/failed refresh and one factory-flow image; stable native/half refresh not qualified.
translation_notes: A0 PSR=0B, TRES=03000228, PON before RAM, full window 83, DRF=01, POF=00.
Portrait image transposed to 768x552, then reordered into ascending controller rows.
A4 observes BUSY_N low then high; AA=90 s is shared, not independent phase limits.
A3 streams 105984 bytes in one window; equivalence to Lab's qualified per-row windows is unverified.
Factory panel MTP/LUT retained; no panel MTP, OTP or volatile LUT writes.
profiles.source_qualification: A0 native command/layout reference; FMSC full-window optical refresh unqualified.

profiles.label: HE037A64 3.7 四色
profiles.qualification: Historical Huawei + PCR532 complete 3.7 four-color image; F1B not qualified.
translation_notes: Factory MTP/LUT retained; no MTP, OTP or volatile LUT writes.
Full vendor init, PON BUSY cycle, post-PON settings, A3=10, DRF, POF, 100 ms, sleep.
A4 waits for BUSY_N low then high; AA=60 s is shared, not Lab's independent 5/60/3 s limits.
Lab checked the full panel MTP fingerprint; this NFC flow does not perform that read.
Native Source=240/Gate=416; user confirmed the complete reference image on the recorded setup.
FMSC size metadata=0; this is custom geometry, not a 2.13-inch screen recipe.
profiles.source_qualification: Complete four-color image confirmed on Huawei 9E56721E with PCR532, 2026-10-11; not a general board qualification.
profiles.hardware_evidence_source: archived-nfc-reference experiment docs/user confirmations through 2026-10-13; NOT a new CLI hardware test

profiles.label: 汉朔 JD79668AA 4.2 四色
profiles.qualification: Historical Huawei + PCR532 complete image/clear with explicit DRF12 00; DSP-only failed.
translation_notes: Native 400x300 TRES and full PTL, never the older padded 400x304 extent.
Packed 2-bpp codes black=0, white=1, yellow=2, red=3; reverse logical rows, not Source columns.
Reset high/low/high 200ms; exact Hanshow init, temperature read, PON low/high, full RAM, frame submission, POF.
DSP path reads 71,51,11; 11 is a refresh trigger, not a harmless read-only probe; no additional DRF.
DSP POF waits high only; DRF path uses the reference low/high POF cycle. No automatic fallback.
A8 requests read clocks; physical A2/A8 equivalence to the native shared-SDA transaction is unverified.
D4/DE do not establish that DSP returned 80 or that panel RAM bytes are correct.
A4/AA provide a shared 120s wait limit, not independent panel-reference phase deadlines.
No MTP, OTP, volatile LUT, foreign-panel waveform, sleep or fast-refresh commands.
profiles.source_qualification: Full test card and complete white frame optically confirmed by user on Huawei UID 9E56721E + COM18 PCR532; 120 D2 packets and D4=9000; DE busy then idle at 24.313s (card), 24.328s (white). Other boards/panels not qualified.
profiles.hardware_evidence_source: archived-nfc-reference experiment docs/user confirmations through 2026-10-13; NOT a new CLI hardware test

profiles.label: HINK-T0154A10-A1 1.54 六色
profiles.qualification: Historical Huawei + PCR532 complete six-color image/clear; F1B flashed then stopped. Pin16 independent.
profiles.recipe_label: OSPtek E6 strict reference (experimental byte-stream alias)
profiles.reference_panel: HT0154A10 / HINK-T0154A10-A1; public source is A3
translation_notes: D2 raw bytes, one A3=10 streamer, full native 4-bpp frame; no on-chip six-color conversion claimed.
User confirmed the complete six-color test pattern on the recorded FMSC/PCR532 setup; repeated refresh is not yet qualified.
FMSC X=960/Y=240, color=20, DA=120030 are byte-count metadata, not the native resolution/palette.
Native high/low nibbles: black=0, white=1, yellow=2, red=3, blue=5, green=6; code 4 unused.
Vendor double reset, five init writes, RAM-first, PON/DRF/POF; no MTP/OTP/LUT writes or deep sleep.
A4 waits for BUSY_N high only, AA=30 s shared limit; not independent per-stage vendor deadlines.
No pending-PON exception: Lab's optically active diagnostic path is not copied automatically.
Pin16 is a separate capacitor rail, not 3.3 V; exact A1 wiring, RESE and boost circuit need checking.
FMSC SPI clock/mode and native MTP fingerprint are not independently checked by this flow.
profiles.source_qualification: Complete six-color image confirmed by user on Huawei 9E56721E with PCR532, 2026-10-12; one 2026-10-11 trial, not a general electrical or repeat-refresh qualification. Phone/iPhone-board compatibility is not qualified; confirm pin16 wiring.
profiles.hardware_evidence_source: archived-nfc-reference experiment docs/user confirmations through 2026-10-13; NOT a new CLI hardware test

profiles.label: HINK-T0169A06-A0 1.69 圆屏六色
profiles.qualification: Historical upload accepted but no optical motion, DE stuck busy. Experimental; pin16 independent.
profiles.recipe_label: OSPtek round E6 strict-PON translation (experimental byte-stream alias)
translation_notes: D3 LZO in 40 raw 2000-byte blocks; D2 cannot address 320 packets with its one-byte P2.
FMSC X=1600/Y=400, color=20, DA=120030 are byte-count metadata, not native resolution/palette.
Native 4-bpp high/low nibbles: black=0, white=1, yellow=2, red=3, blue=5, green=6.
Round-only init FF:A5, D6:00, FF:E3, E9:01; no 1.54 AE/31 writes.
A3 sends 0x10 and streams data internally; vendor wait between DTM command and data cannot be expressed independently.
Strict RAM-first PON/DRF/POF with BUSY_N high waits; no pending-PON exception, MTP/OTP/LUT write or deep sleep.
AA=30 s is a shared FMSC wait limit, not independent vendor per-stage deadlines.
32pin adapter, rear pins and capacitor nodes must be verified; pin16 is NOT 3.3 V.
Native MTP fingerprint and SPI clock/mode are reference evidence, not checked by this NFC flow.
profiles.source_qualification: First NFC trial accepted configuration, 40 D3 blocks and D4, but DE stayed busy and user saw no reaction; optical refresh failed. Phone/iPhone-board compatibility is not qualified; confirm pin16 wiring.
profiles.hardware_evidence_source: archived-nfc-reference experiment docs/user confirmations through 2026-10-13; NOT a new CLI hardware test

profiles.label: HT037A02 3.7 E6 (experimental)
profiles.qualification: Historical Huawei upload accepted, refresh RF timeout/no completion; exceeds F1B budget. Pin16 independent.
profiles.recipe_label: OSPtek 3.7 E6 strict-PON translation (experimental byte-stream alias)
profiles.reference_panel: HT037A02 / HINK-T037A02-A1 / EPD037A02, 32pin; not HE037A64 BWRY
translation_notes: D3 LZO: 87 blocks, 86x2000 plus an 800-byte tail. Full native 4-bpp frame, no two-pass image split.
FMSC X=1920/Y=720, color=20, DA=120030 are byte-count metadata, not native geometry/palette.
Native nibble codes black=0, white=1, yellow=2, red=3, blue=5, green=6; code 4 unused.
Double reset low20/high10/low20/high10 ms, E9:01 only, RAM before PON; no 1.54 AE/31 or round FF/D6 init.
A3 internally sends DTM=10 and data; the vendor wait after the command and before pixels is not independently reproduced.
Strict PON, DRF and POF BUSY-high waits; no pending-PON bypass.
AA=60 s is shared; independent Lab PON/DRF/POF deadlines and bounded POF-on-error cleanup are not reproduced inside DB.
No PSR, TRES, PLL, voltage, LUT or MTP writes, and no deep sleep. FMSC SPI timing and panel RAM contents unverified.
Verify the exact 32pin adapter/capacitor nodes. Pin16 is VSH3-VSPL2, NOT 3.3 V; rear pins are not optional by assumption.
Huawei 9E56721E accepted a complete 172800-byte frame once; do not generalize capacity to other boards. Reject inadequate D1 slots or the first rejected D3; never refresh a partial frame.
profiles.source_qualification: First strict NFC trial on Huawei 9E56721E accepted all 87 D3 blocks and D4; recorded DE replies stayed 01, without optical qualification. panel-reference optical success used a separately armed pending-PON diagnostic.
profiles.hardware_evidence_source: archived-nfc-reference experiment docs/user confirmations through 2026-10-13; NOT a new CLI hardware test
